🚨 Kunal Kamra's Remark Goes Viral on Social Media  
  
Comedian Kunal Kamra has once again sparked discussion online with a political quip during a public performance.  
  
The line being widely shared is:  
  
«"Sita ke pati ka naam leke, Nita ke pati ka kaam kar rahe hai."»
